critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correctly localized: MeetingCreate.send_invite_email defaults to False, and the queue_email branch in POST /meetings is gated on `payload.send_invite_email and scheduled_for and contact_email` (v3_routes.py line 9282). Defense-in-depth is good: the suppress branch logs the reason so any future regression is observable in backend logs.

Frontend saveConnectTranscriptSessions + v3CreateMeeting do not forward send_invite_email - the default-False on the Pydantic model is the single source of truth. This is the safer design (opt-in for emails, never opt-out).

Only callers in the backend that should set send_invite_email=True today are the explicit 'Send to brand email' button flow (POST /connect/send-meeting-email) and any future schedule-and-notify flows; no implicit caller in the transcript save loop or analyze-all background job sets it, which matches the acceptance criteria.

Minor: /api/v3/admin/email-outbox endpoint returns 404 (no endpoint defined). It is referenced in the testing brief but not actually present in the backend. Direct Motor queries via MONGO_URL are the only way to verify outbox state. Not a bug for the fix being verified; flag for awareness if main agent wants to add an admin email-outbox listing endpoint for future regression tests.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug is fully fixed. The acceptance pattern to preserve in future regression tests: (1) POST /api/v3/meetings with scheduled_for + contact_email + meeting_type='business_call' WITHOUT send_invite_email must NOT queue a business_call_invite email and MUST log 'meeting_invite_email_suppressed reason=send_invite_email_default_false meeting_id=... brand_id=...'. (2) Only send_invite_email=True (explicit opt-in) may queue exactly 1 invite email. (3) The dedicated 'Send to brand email' endpoint (POST /api/v3/business-cases/{id}/connect/send-meeting-email) is the only user-facing path that should set send_invite_email=True OR call queue_email itself. (4) The frontend save loop in V1BusinessCaseFlowPages.js (saveConnectTranscriptSessions) intentionally does NOT pass send_invite_email, relying on the Pydantic default. (5) /api/v3/admin/email-outbox does not exist - use direct Motor against db.v3_email_outbox with the test contact_email + kind='business_call_invite' filter to assert ZERO new docs.
rca of the issue: Root cause (already fixed by main agent in this iteration): POST /api/v3/meetings unconditionally enqueued a business_call_invite email whenever the payload had scheduled_for + contact_email + meeting_type='business_call'. The V1 Connect Schedule 'Analyze All' flow calls v3CreateMeeting once per transcript (saveConnectTranscriptSessions). With 4 transcripts the brand contact received 4 invite emails. Fix: added `send_invite_email: bool = False` to the MeetingCreate Pydantic model (v3_routes.py L9142) with a security comment, and gated the queue_email branch (L9282) on this flag. A suppressed-branch logger was added (L9315-9319) so non-opt-in calls are observable for audit. Frontend was NOT changed - it relies on the default-False so any future caller that wants to opt in must do so explicitly. Verification: 4 backend pytest cases + 1 add-transcript regression case + analyze-all bg-job 4-case suite + a full end-to-end V1 admin UI smoke (this iteration) all PASS with ZERO business_call_invite emails queued during the analyze-all flow.
